name: Alexei Kosygin
contribution: A Soviet statesman who served as the Chairman of the Council of Ministers from 1964 to 1980.
legacy: Upon Khrushchev's ouster, this person initially emerged as the Soviet Union's head of government in both name and practice.

checks.lead: Alexei Nikolayevich Kosygin (21 February [O.S. 8 February] 1904 – 18 December 1980) was a Soviet statesman who served as the Chairman of the Council of Ministers from 1964 to 1980. Following Nikita Khrushchev's removal from power, he briefly led the Soviet Union as part of a triumvirate in the mid-to-late 1960s.
